description: Application for issuance of Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card requiring Identity, Address, and Date of Birth verification.

requirements.name: Proof of Identity
requirements.description: Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID Card, Driving License, or Arms License.
requirements.validation_hints: Name must match the exact spelling desired on the PAN card.

requirements.name: Proof of Address
requirements.description: Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, Electricity Bill, Water Bill, or Bank Account Statement (dated within 3 months).
requirements.validation_hints: Must reflect current address where physical PAN card will be dispatched.

requirements.name: Proof of Date of Birth
requirements.description: Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Matriculation Certificate, or Passport containing birth date.
requirements.validation_hints: Date of birth must be clearly legible and match identity proof.
